statement: Charisma is the byte at DS:4E: this routine adds it to intelligence to scale a quoted price, and a character whose DS:4E held 0x20 printed CHARISMA-20.
The price derived here scales on the bit length of intelligence plus charisma, so it moves with the two together rather than with either alone.
This routine adds the two stat bytes with a plain `adc` and takes the bit length of the sum, so at this site the stat bytes are read as binary integers.
